column3: MT 36:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. The Hebrew reads “in the midst of my heart”; NASB renders “Transgression speaks to the ungodly within his heart.”
The Hebrew is obscure; NASB renders the second line “Concerning the discovery of his iniquity and the hatred of it.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “he does not reject” is rendered “He does not despise.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “extends to” and “reaches to.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the fatness of Your house” is rendered “the abundance of Your house.”
Close to the Hebrew; “prolong” is rendered “continue.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make me wander” is rendered “drive me away.”
